title: Add a game · Complete the form

marks.label: Click Add game to open the new-game form on the right.
Enter the game name and English name. The names shown here are examples.
Set Mod folder to the deployment folder that your loader actually reads.
Check the paths, then click Confirm to save the game configuration.

title: Activate a game · Check the current environment

marks.label: Double-click a game card to activate it. Double-click the active game again to deactivate it.
Current environment and the Current badge identify the active game.
Check the loader folder and Mod deployment folder before enabling a Mod.

title: Category Overview · Find categories and common actions

marks.label: Double-click a category card, such as 外观 (Appearance), to enter it before importing Mods.
The breadcrumb shows your current location. Click All to return to the category root.
Search by name, author or tag, and narrow the results with tag and type filters.
Use the preset selector to manage the current game's complete Mod loadout.

title: Inspect a Mod · Information, state and actions

marks.label: Check the Mod name, enabled state and selected variant at the top of its details.
Switch between Information, Keys and Variants to inspect each part of the Mod.
Click Edit to change the name, author, tags and description.
An enabled Mod shows Disable. Disabling it keeps the original in your library.

title: Import Mods · Choose sources and confirm

marks.label: Use Add Files or Add Folder to select one or more sources.
Review each item's age rating and preview. The destination is the category you opened before importing.
Click Confirm Import, then follow progress in the task center at the lower right.

title: Mod keys · Record or edit a binding

marks.label: Select a Mod and open Keys. These bindings belong to the Mod's INI files.
Click the current key to record a new binding, or use the edit icon to type one.
Open the INI file when you need to inspect the surrounding configuration.

title: Variants · Save different looks for one Mod

marks.label: Select a Mod and open Variants.

marks.target: 保存当前状态为新变体
marks.label: Save the current supported appearance state as a new named variant.
Choose a saved look. The variant currently in use has a status marker.

title: Combination presets · Save and switch loadouts

marks.label: Create a new combination preset here.
Click Apply beside a preset to switch to its complete loadout.
Select a preset before renaming or copying it.

title: Edit a Mod · Update information and tags

marks.target: 同时重命名 Mod 文件或文件夹
marks.label: Clear this option to change only the display name. Selecting it also renames the disk item.
Add or adjust tags, and check the scope when changing a shared tag.
Click Save changes, or press Ctrl+Enter, to save your edits.

title: Category presets · Import or export a category tree

marks.label: Import a .d3dxcp file, then review the destination game and differences in the category tree.
Export the category structure and optional category images. Mod archives are not included.

title: General settings · Deletion and task concurrency

marks.label: Open Settings → General, then select a settings group on the left.
Choose permanent deletion or the Recycle Bin, and check the operation's scope before proceeding.
Start with Auto recommend if you are unsure, then adjust concurrency to suit your disk.

title: Personalization · Theme, language and fonts

marks.label: Choose a light, dark or system theme in the appearance card.
Choose your interface language from this list.
Open the language-pack folder to customize translations, then refresh the list.
Select an interface font and check that text and symbols display correctly.

title: Shortcuts · Change the manager's key bindings

marks.label: Open Settings → Shortcuts → Key bindings.
Click a binding to record a new shortcut. Follow the prompt if it conflicts with another action.
Restore resets only this shortcut. Reset at the bottom restores all application preferences after confirmation; game configurations and imported Mods are retained.

title: Import settings · Archive formats and conversion

marks.label: Choose the library archive format used when importing folders.
Review Always use the import format. Enabling it may require extraction and recompression.
Use Export on the left for export formats, category folders and metadata options.

title: Online proxy · Configure both switches

marks.label: Enable the proxy in the online Mod proxy group.
Open the general proxy settings, enter the actual proxy address and enable its main switch.
Use Mod updates on the left to configure update checks for local Mods.

title: Application updates · Check for a new version

marks.label: Check for application updates to view new releases and release notes.
Review the backup option. It backs up application files and does not replace a backup of your Mod data.

marks.target: 自动（镜像优先，失败回退）
marks.label: Choose a download source for your network. Version checks still require a valid release feed.

title: Tools · Category presets and maintenance

marks.label: Import a category tree after reviewing new entries and conflicts.
Export the current game's complete category tree as a .d3dxcp file.
Rebuild the index only if a normal refresh does not resolve the library issue.
Open the log viewer here when troubleshooting or reporting a problem.

title: Plugins · Install, enable and manage

marks.label: Install a plugin archive here. After copying a plugin folder manually, click Rescan.
Select a plugin in the list to see its details on the right.
Check the source and permissions before enabling it. First-time activation asks you to confirm trust.

marks.target: 权限与来源 · 7 项权限
marks.label: Expand Permissions and source to review capabilities. Reload and uninstall are below the description.

title: About · Project information and short film

marks.label: Click About at the lower left to open the project information.
Click Watch film to play the project film inside the page.

title: Delete a game · Review what will be removed

marks.label: Check the resource counts, deployment count and size to confirm the selected game.
Review each item to be removed, and back up or export anything you want to keep.
Permanent deletion bypasses the Recycle Bin. Click Cancel if the scope is unclear.

title: Gallery · Find a Mod by its preview

marks.label: Click a preview card to locate the Mod in Category Overview. Double-click to toggle its enabled state.
Choose how rated previews are displayed. This setting does not delete or disable Mods.

title: Add categories in bulk · One entry per row

marks.label: Enter a category name and optional English name for each row.
Choose Category or Character/Object. The node type determines whether Mods can coexist.
Add another row here.
Check every row, then click Add all to create the entries at the current level.

title: Logs · Select the session before investigating

marks.label: Choose the application session in which the problem occurred.
Keep All to include context before and after an error. A level filter shows only that level.
Open the log folder for complete files, or copy the current contents with Copy.

title: Browse online Mods · Find an entry, then its files

marks.label: Search by keyword. Use the breadcrumb below to choose an online category.
Click a Mod card to read its description and available downloads.
Use the sorting menu to order entries by newest, recently updated or popularity.

title: Export a category tree · Name, images and location

marks.label: Enter a preset name for sharing and check the selected game.
Include category images if needed. Review the complete export scope in the tree on the right.
Choose an output location and check the resulting filename below.
Click Start export after completing all required fields.

title: Search settings · Jump to an option

marks.label: Type a keyword such as cache in the settings search box.
Click a result to open its group. Clear the search to return to normal browsing.

title: Images and cache · Memory versus disk

marks.label: Open Settings → General → Images and cache.
Clear cached image memory. Images currently displayed stay available; other images reload when needed.
Clear regenerable disk caches here; this is not the action for deleting original Mods.

title: Window background · Choose a source

marks.label: Open Settings → Personalization → Window background.
Choose Close (off), Image, Video or WE scene, then supply the media or application path for that type.

title: Online details · Read the description and choose a file

marks.label: Read the author's information in Overview and Description first.
Check filenames and sizes. Different files may be versions or optional extras.
Click the download button beside the file you want, then choose its installation destination.

title: Create a category ① · Open the creation dialog

marks.label: Activate a game, then open Category Overview on the left.
On an empty page, click + New Category. With existing content, right-click a blank area and choose New Category.

title: Create a category ② · Fill in and confirm

marks.label: Enter a category name, such as 外观 (Appearance). Add an English name and image if needed.
Choose a node type. Categories allow multiple enabled Mods; Character/Object nodes enforce mutually exclusive appearances.
Click Confirm to create the category, then double-click its new card to enter it.

title: Inside a category · Import your first Mod

marks.label: The breadcrumb should show a specific category. This example uses the empty 待整理 (Inbox) category.
Click Import Mod, drop an archive or folder into the content area, or press Ctrl+I.

title: Enable a Mod · Select it, then enable

marks.label: Click the Mod you want to enable to show its details on the right.
Click Enable and wait for deployment. You can also double-click the card, or select it and press Space.
When deployment finishes, the state becomes Enabled and the action changes to Disable.
